verses.text: A psalm of Asaph. God takes his place in the great meeting. He gives judgment among the "gods":
"How long will you judge unfairly and take the side of the wicked? Selah.
Defend the weak, the poor, and those with no father. Protect the rights of the poor and the crushed.
Rescue the weak and needy. Save them from the power of the wicked."
They know nothing. They understand nothing. They walk around in the dark, while all the foundations of the earth are shaking.
I said, "You are gods. All of you are sons of the Most High.
But you will die like ordinary people. You will fall like any other ruler."
Get up, God, and judge the earth, because all the nations belong to you.
